description: Towards a Flow-oriented Visualisation Approach for Electric Power System Situational Awareness is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Arash Beiranvand, Paul Cuffe. It is not always easy to apprehend the prevailing disposition of power flows through an electrical network. Typically, power system one line diagrams are drawn in a pseudo geographic way. This depiction may obscure where the bulk power flows or the corridors of coherent flow are for a particular operational snapshot. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1203028 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
